capabilityGaps: API-019: documented authentication accepts bearer or X-Session-ID credentials and sets no auth cookies; rejected cookie-only requests do not prove a cookie-CSRF defense.
API-016: no bulk endpoint is exercised or treated as an implemented secure denial.
API-017/018: the tests do not establish complete route/spec security parity and inventory alone is not behavior evidence.

HTTP CORS and WebSocket Origin are distinct: ALLOWED_ORIGINS controls WebSocket handshake in this fixture; these HTTP routes do not emit Access-Control-Allow-Origin or Allow-Credentials for either tested origin.

API-023 is a preserved real source11 failing regression; the earlier run misidentified the literal documentation word SQLite as a secret, corrected by comparing actual secret values and sensitive fields rather than banning a product technology name.

The source11 API-023 missing-header failure is retained as historical evidence; source12 final-response-hook tests pass, including actual 413 and 429 checks. The post-restart 429 test reconnects unthrottled IRC witnesses and does not assert rate-limiter persistence.

The original source12 unfiltered run remains 472 passed / 1 failed from an Undici read ECONNRESET on an unauthenticated oversized PATCH; exact request tracing and two independent public-HTTP diagnostics captured complete 413 responses before adopting a response-aware test client. No production source changed.
